task.title: Setting tag expiration using annotations
task.shortdesc: To expire an image tag automatically in Red Hat Quay, you can push an image with a quay.expires-after annotation. You can apply the annotation to manifests and indexes.

ul.li: You have downloaded the oras CLI.

context.p: You can add an annotation, for example, quay.expires-after=20h, by using the --annotation flag when you push an image. The following values for hours, days, or weeks are accepted:
Expiration begins from the time that the image is pushed to the registry.

note.p: Using the --annotation flag is simplest using the oras CLI tool.

step.cmd: Enter the following oras push --annotation command to add an annotation to the desired image tag. The annotation should be in the format quay.expires-after=<value> to indicate that the tag should expire the set time. For example:
